accessions.GSE304653: bulk RNA-seq of flow-sorted Met1-iRFP tumour fractions (S8.p1, S2.4.p1)

assay: Met1-iRFP orthotopic tumours digested, sorted into iRFP+ (cancer) and iRFP- (TME); KAPA stranded mRNA; HiSeq 2x50; STAR mm10 + featureCounts gencode vM18 (S2.4.p1)
sample_inclusion: female FVB mice, Met1-iRFP grafted; voluntary wheel running vs sedentary (no wheel) from day 3 for ~15 days (S2.1.2.p1, S2.2.p1)
TME RNA-seq: exercise n=4, control n=4 (FIG2C)
cancer-cell RNA-seq: exercise n=7, control n=8, 'from the same tumors' (S3.p4, FIG3B)
sample_exclusion: missed fat-pad injection, ulceration, or injury that prohibited exercise (S2.1.p1); not identifiable at the sample level
primary_estimand: Effect of voluntary wheel running vs sedentary control on gene expression of (a) the iRFP- tumour-microenvironment fraction and (b) the iRFP+ cancer-cell fraction of Met1 tumours, each fraction analysed separately.
repeated_measure_unit: mouse; one sample per mouse per fraction; fractions from the same tumours are analysed separately
paper_method: DESeq2 (Bioconductor) on featureCounts gene counts (S2.4.p1); design formula and prefilter not reported

enrichment.TME: GSEA Hallmark (mouse) on all genes ranked by log2FC via genekitr; BH p_adj < 0.05 (S2.4.p1, FIG2B)
enrichment.Cancer: Reactome ORA on up/down DEGs; IPA functions (S2.4.p1, S3.p4, FIG3D)
